name: Hugging Face Dataset Viewer API (datasets-server)
summary: Free API to read rows, splits, schemas, statistics and Parquet files of public Hugging Face Hub datasets without downloading them.
description: The dataset viewer API serves the contents of public datasets on the Hugging Face Hub: list configs and splits, page through rows, run full-text search and SQL-like filters, get column statistics, dataset size and the auto-converted Parquet file URLs. It is a separate host from the Hub API that lists and searches the datasets themselves.

auth.notes: Public datasets work without a token; private and gated datasets need a Hugging Face user token sent as Authorization: Bearer <token>.

rate_limit.summary: Not documented for this host in the pages fetched.

endpoints.summary: Configs and splits of a dataset
Page through rows of a split
Full-text search in the text columns of a split
Rows matching a SQL-like where clause (and orderby)
URLs of the Parquet conversion of every split

example.response_excerpt: {"features":[{"feature_idx":0,"name":"text","type":{"dtype":"string","_type":"Value"}},{"feature_idx":1,"name":"label","type":{"names":["neg","pos"],"_type":"ClassLabel"}}],"rows":[{"row_idx":0,"row":{"text":"I rented I AM CURIOUS-YELLOW from my video store ...","label":0},"truncated_cells":[]}],"num_rows_total":25000,"num_rows_per_page":100,"partial":false}

license.name: Per dataset; each dataset sets its own licence on the Hub

agent_notes: Call /splits first to get the exact config and split names, then /rows. length is capped at 100 per call; paginate with offset. Large datasets may be only partially converted (partial: true in the response). For bulk reads use the Parquet URLs from /parquet instead of paging rows. Dataset discovery (search by name, tags) is on the Hub API, not on this host.
caveats: The /search and /filter endpoints returned HTTP 500 'Authentication check on the Hugging Face Hub failed or timed out' on several attempts, while /rows, /splits, /size, /statistics, /info and /parquet answered 200; /search worked once on a later try.
/filter wants a quoted column name inside where, for example where="label"=1, URL-encoded.
The openapi.json path on the host answers 302 to the GitHub-hosted spec.

verification.notes: Exact example request executed without a key.
